positions.title: Lead Desktop Support Technician
positions.description:
Managed internal desktop support and operations for 900+ users across the company headquarters and 23 branch locations.  Established and trained staff on work processes for desktop support.  Prioritized tasks and tickets within the team while maintaining quality control work on critical and high priority incidents.  Maintained and organized inventory of IT equipment for users.  
Achievements:
•	Increased and maintained positive survey results to above 90% scores for all technicians on the team by implementing customer check-ins and increasing team communication.
•	Played an integral role in planning and upgrading all users to Win10 systems ahead of schedule to keep all computers in compliance with support.
•	Migrated a primarily in-office company to fully remote with minimal IT impact by working with leadership to establish processes and implement training

positions.title: Member Services Representative
positions.description:
Answered and responded to  member inquires via telephone and email regarding membership, banking products, services, and rates while providing friendly, accurate and speedy service.  Maintained high call numbers consistently to better serve customers and help with avoiding long wait times.  
Achievements:
•	Assisted in documenting reports of calls presented and finding any discrepancies between reports to better serve and route customer calls.

positions.title: Valet
positions.description: Providing great customer service and ensuring the safety of client vehicles and pedestrians.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Working within the company’s multiple teams I was exposed to a 3-step software development process which was: Developing, Testing and Releasing.  I was also part of a team that not only developed new software but also updated and modified preexisting software programs using Java, Python & C.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description: Performed as a cashier for the majority of the time I was an associate at Wawa.  I also provided sandwiches for customers, answered the phone, and was assigned to replenishing store shelves with on-hand inventory.

positions.title: Computer Intern
positions.description: Introduced me to an IT environment, dynamic pressures and responsibilities.  Some of my responsibilities included setting up school-based PCs and configuring the domain for the computers.  Other tasks were office-based working with data in Microsoft Applications.
